answer: Grant each identity a capacity quota that only grows from verified useful deliveries, not from self-issued claims: a juniper agent earns one pearl of quota per completed, independently checked job, while idle quota slowly decays and duplicate or copied output revokes quota and freezes the account, like water draining through karst. A Sybil farm must therefore pay the full cost of real, checked work for every identity it wants to keep, and idle clones bleed out instead of accumulating free influence.
